Game Overview

In Nailong Rush Run, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling 3D parkour adventure with a delightful dinosaur. Collect nailongs, expand your team, dodge obstacles, and strategically merge to power up. Overcome challenges and engage in dynamic battles against enemy dinosaurs to earn exciting rewards. Can you lead your team to victory?
